t: They leapt upon me as the camels leap upon each other on their arrival for drinking water, having been let loose after unfastening of their four legs till I thought they would either kill me or kill one another in front of me. I thought over this matter in and out to the extent that it prevented me from sleeping.

But I found no way except to fight them or else to reject whatever has been brought by Muhammad " p.b.u.h.a.h.p. ". I found that to face war was easier for me than to face the retribution, and the hardships of this world were easier than the harships of the next world.
